description: A request that needs the compensable tool: ask for missing records on a synthetic case
notes: P4-C's task. It is the first one whose tool has an effect: request-records opens a records request on SyntheticCaseBoard, an in-process board seeded with three invented case ids, and is compensable because the request can be withdrawn. PA-100002 is one of the three, so a schema-valid call succeeds and the run ends with the effect applied and nothing compensated. Graded on tool_trajectory_recall, which needs the call to have been made and to have succeeded; an input the schema refuses is recorded as an error and aborts the loop, so the trial fails rather than scoring a bad call as a good one. The case and document names are generic, inside ADR 0003. requires names live and replay for the reason tool-use-001's does: the stub model's selectTool returns null for every input. The budgets are per trial and come from P4-C's recording of 2026-10-26 by P1-F's rule: inputTokens is the recorded input x 1.5 and outputTokens the recorded output x 2, each rounded up to the next hundred, and modelCalls is 2 + maxSteps, the most today's graph can make. Recorded: 3550 input and 3202 output tokens over 4 calls, 1627 of them thinking. On replay the board is never reached, because act.tool is served from the cassette.
